summary: §7 RESPONSIVE ACCEPTANCE SWEEP (frontend only, READ-ONLY, no mutations). Logged in as hostbay@moxx.co via the 2-step login and swept /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links, /invoices, /customers, /wallet, /settings plus public /, /auth/register, /payment/success, /payment/failed using REAL Playwright viewports 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844 in light AND dark, with networkidle + wait_for_selector hydration waits and computed-style/geometry probes (document scrollWidth, per-container clipping detection, touch-target heights, font-family/text-align of money, filled-pill detection, WCAG contrast math). RESULT: nav pattern is correct at 1920/1440/1280/768/390 but WRONG at exactly 1024 (full sidebar instead of icon rail) which also CLIPS the dashboard right column; the 390 in-app top bar clips the avatar on every authenticated page; the landing top nav clips the primary 'Start free' CTA at 1280; and §4.2 table rules are violated on 4 pages (pay-links/transactions become cards at 768, invoices/customers stay tables at 390, transactions ID column is not sticky). Quiet-money rules PASS (no filled status pills, coin chips are transparent+hairline, money is IBM Plex Mono). No page-level horizontal scroll anywhere. Console was clean except transient 502s on /wallet.

minor.issue: Two 'Failed to load resource: status 502' console errors while loading /wallet at 390x844 (dark). Not reproducible on a later 1440 load - transient upstream/proxy 502. Worth confirming which wallet endpoint 502'd.

ui_bugs.issue: §7 FAIL at width EXACTLY 1024: full 265px sidebar renders instead of the 72px icon rail. The rail media query is '(min-width:768px) and (max-width:1023.95px)', so 1024 falls into the desktop branch. Should be max-width:1024px (or min-width:1025px for full).

Direct consequence of the above: at 1024x768 the right rail (data-testid=dash2026-fee-tier and dashboard-grow-panel) spans left 778 -> right 1052 inside a viewport-width overflow:hidden container with NO scrollable ancestor => permanently clipped by 28px ('$100,000', '$72,879.79 to next tier', 'Reach Scale tier...' are cut). The 4th quick-action button ('Transactions') is also cut at the right edge. Light and dark identical.

Right cluster overflows the phone viewport on EVERY authenticated page: the avatar IMG measures left 379 -> right 403 at iw=390, so the avatar/user-menu is half cut off; the header wrapper reports scrollWidth 431 vs clientWidth 390 inside an overflow:hidden box (verified on /dashboard, /transactions, /pay-links, /settings, /invoices, /customers). Company pill + New + bell + ThemeToggle + avatar do not fit at 390.

Marketing header row measures 637px wide extending to right=1344 at iw=1280 with no scroll container: the primary CTA 'Start free' is visually clipped at the right edge (screenshot shows 'Star...'). Not reproduced at 1440/1024 (hamburger). Light theme confirmed.

Many primary controls are 28-39px tall at 1024/768/390: header-create-new 28px (34px wide at 390), header-notifications-bell 31px, sidebar-collapse-toggle 32px, transactions-source-chip-* 32px, Period / All Wallets selects 32px, settings-rail-* 39px, language rows 30px, /payment/success 'Return home' 35px. (Sidebar rail items themselves ARE 54x44 - PASS.)

Bottom tab bar exposes only 3 tabs (Dashboard / Payment Links / Transactions) + an expander, not the blueprint's Dashboard/Payments/Wallet/More. Functionally fine (hamburger drawer gives full nav) but does not match the §4.1 spec in the review request.
'Try again' button is ~108px wide and its label wraps onto two lines; the two action buttons are visually cramped side-by-side on a phone. Consider full-width stacked buttons <=390.

integration_issues.issue: At 768x1024 BOTH /transactions and /pay-links render the phone CARD LIST (document.querySelector('table') === null, card rows with per-row action icon buttons). Blueprint requires table + horizontal scroll affordance at >=768 and cards only at <=640.

At 390x844 /invoices (Receipts & Tax) and /customers still render a real MuiTable inside a 324px MuiTableContainer with scrollWidth 415 / 429 - the Total/amount column is visibly cut mid-value ('$1...') and there is no visible scroll affordance. These two pages never switch to cards.

/transactions desktop grid (div-based, no <table>) scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth 1396 vs clientWidth 1105 at 1440) but the 'Transaction ID' first column is NOT position:sticky - scrolling right makes the ID column disappear entirely, so rows become unidentifiable. Also no visual scroll affordance (no edge fade/hint) at 1440 where 'Date & Time' and 'Status' are off-screen by default.

issues: No white-on-white / black-on-black anywhere; cards, hairline borders and KPI values all visible in dark (body #09090B, surfaces #18181B, dividers #27272A). Dashboard KPI, transactions grid, settings and invoices all render correctly in dark.
AA misses: sidebar section labels ('GET PAID', 'MONEY', 'YOUR SETUP', 'ACCOUNT') are #71717A on #18181B = 3.67:1 at 10.5px (needs 4.5).
Primary filled buttons ('Create payment link', active source chip) are #FFF on #6366F1 = 4.47:1 at 13-15px - marginally under AA; darken to #4F46E5 in dark or bump weight/size.
PASS: statuses are dot + text (settled/unpaid/paid/expired) with transparent parents - zero filled status pills found.
PASS: coin chips are backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0) with a 1px hairline (#E2E8F0) - no coloured chip fills.
PASS: money renders in IBM Plex Mono and is visually right-aligned in the transactions grid / card rows; 3 typefaces observed (IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, display face).
Minor: transaction CARDS at <=768 carry a coloured left accent bar per coin (orange BTC / purple ETH) - the only remaining coin-derived colour surface.

The hero product mock bleeds past the right viewport edge (right ~443-1126 vs viewport) so its 'LIVE' pill is cut; document has no horizontal scroll so this reads as an unintentional crop rather than a designed bleed.
The price ticker marquee legitimately overflows inside its own clipped track - no page overflow. OK.
Marketing 'LIVE' badge uses a filled green tint rgba(34,197,94,0.1) and $5/$10 use indigo tints - acceptable for marketing but they are extra accent surfaces if §7 is applied to the landing page too.

The section rail is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth 1159 vs clientWidth 326 at 390; 768 similar) showing only 'Profile & Security | Notifications' with no fade/arrow affordance - the remaining sections (incl. settings-rail-referrals at left 1048) are discoverable only by blind swipe.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): widen the tablet-rail media query in /app/Containers/Client/index.tsx to '(min-width:768px) and (max-width:1024px)' so 1024 shows the 72px icon rail per §7 - this also removes the 28px clipping of the dashboard right column at 1024.

FIX (HIGH): make the 390 in-app top bar fit - the avatar/user-menu is clipped on every authenticated page (header scrollWidth 431 vs 390). Drop/condense the company pill or the New button below 400px.
FIX (HIGH): landing top nav at 1280 clips the primary 'Start free' CTA - tighten nav spacing or switch to the compact/hamburger nav below ~1360px.
FIX (§4.2): /transactions and /pay-links must stay TABLES at 768 (they currently render the phone card list).
FIX (§4.2): /invoices and /customers must become CARD LISTS at <=640 (they currently render clipped tables at 390 with no scroll affordance).

FIX (§4.2): make the transactions grid's Transaction ID column position:sticky left:0 and add a horizontal scroll affordance (edge fade) - at 1440 the Date & Time / Status columns are off-screen by default and scrolling right loses the ID.

FIX (§7 touch targets): raise header-create-new (28px), header-notifications-bell (31px), sidebar-collapse-toggle (32px), transactions source chips (32px), Period/All Wallets selects (32px), settings rail items (39px) to >=44px at <=1024.
POLISH (a11y): sidebar section labels 3.67:1 and white-on-#6366F1 4.47:1 are just under WCAG AA in dark mode.
CHECK: transient 502s observed on /wallet XHRs (390 dark) - confirm which endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Containers/Client/index.tsx: the rail band is expressed twice with different boundaries - useMediaQuery('(min-width:768px) and (max-width:1023.95px)') for isTabletRail while the sidebar visibility uses '@media (min-width:768px)'. The 1023.95 upper bound makes exactly 1024 (the width the blueprint calls out) fall to the desktop branch. Centralise the band in one constant/hook and use max-width:1024px.

The dashboard right column at 1024 has no min-width guard: with a 265px sidebar + 24px gap the two-column grid needs ~1052px, and both wrapper Boxes use overflow:hidden, so the excess is silently clipped instead of wrapping. Give the grid a single-column fallback below ~1100px.

Table responsiveness is implemented inconsistently per page: pay-links/transactions flip to cards at 768 (sm/md breakpoint mismatch) while invoices/customers never flip. Extract one shared 'responsive table' primitive (table >=768 with sticky first column + scroll shadow, cards <=640) and use it on all four pages.
Transactions desktop grid is div-based (no <table>/<th>) - besides the missing sticky ID column this costs screen-reader table semantics; consider role=table/row/cell or real table markup.

success_rate.frontend: Nav pattern 5/6 breakpoints PASS (1024 FAIL); no-horizontal-overflow 6/6 PASS at document level; no-clipping 3/6 PASS (390 header, 1024 dashboard, 390 invoices/customers FAIL); tables §4.2 0/4 pages fully compliant; touch targets FAIL at <=1024; typography/money PASS; quiet-money PASS; dark-mode parity PASS with 2 minor AA misses; register + payment/success + payment/failed 4/4 PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: Working recipes on this pod: (1) login as above. (2) Theme is route-scoped: localStorage 'theme-mode-inapp' for /dashboard-family, 'theme-mode-public' for landing/auth/payment-result; set then reload. (3) Landing page never reaches networkidle (live price ticker) - use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_timeout(4-6s) for '/' or it times out at 90s. (4) Detect clipping, not just page overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth on EVERY page/breakpoint here, so the real defects only show up by comparing child getBoundingClientRect().right against overflow:hidden ancestors. (5) The nav-pattern probe that worked: [data-sidebar-collapsed] attribute + width for sidebar/rail, [data-testid=mobile-navigation-bar] and [data-testid=mobile-hamburger-toggle] for phone chrome. Verified widths: 1920 sidebar 324px, 1440/1280/1024 sidebar 265px, 768 rail 72px (tooltip 'Transactions' works, item 54x44), 390 bottom bar + drawer (390px wide, opens fine). (6) Not covered: /pay hosted checkout and the /hostbay creator page were NOT swept (deprioritised after the in-app findings), and no modal/drawer was opened at 768/1024 (only the 390 hamburger drawer).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the two HIGH nav/clipping defects is a single off-by-one breakpoint: Containers/Client/index.tsx defines the tablet rail as (min-width:768px) and (max-width:1023.95px), so at exactly 1024 the layout keeps the 265px full sidebar; the remaining 735px of content cannot fit the dashboard's two-column grid (needs ~1052px) and both wrapper Boxes use overflow:hidden, clipping the fee-tier/grow column by 28px. The 390 header clipping is an unconstrained flex row (company pill + New + bell + theme toggle + avatar = 431px of intrinsic width inside a 358px content box) with no shrink/hide rule below 400px. The §4.2 table violations come from each page implementing its own card/table switch at a different MUI breakpoint (md vs sm vs never).
